'''Revelation I'm gonna Profit while I Destroy''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Profit Revelation LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Comments appreciated.

The published list has 73 cards.

== Strategy ==

Okay, just free Han and kill everything. Beatdown, beatdown, yeah, beatdown, beatdown. Cam Solusar: I'm getting Redar and Outrider soon! And when I get the SE Red Squadron pilots and their ships, I'll put them in. It's just a question of not having the cards. I assume you mean Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner? Yeah, I didn't think of that. I'll put that in. Thanks. Shewski: I quote, "Qui-Gon is a must!" I quote: "Qui-Gon I don't have!" : ) Besides, what's the big deal with Qui-Gon? I have yet to see his usefulness.
